# Assignment

Create a self-contained R script or Rmarkdown file to do the following:

Import the bear data formatted for `secr` and fit the null model and a model where $g_0$ varies among the 8 occasions. Use `secr` to determine what an appropriate buffer should be.

Import the bear data formatted for `JAGS` (using the command `load("jags_bear_data.gzip")`) and tabulate the capture frequencies and the number of spatial recapture. Fit the model with occasion-specific $g_0$ in `JAGS`, and compare estimates and 95% CIs for $g_0$, $\sigma$, $E[N]$ and $N$ with the results from `secr`.

```{r setup}
library(secr)
library(jagsUI)

sch <- read.capthist(captfile="secr_bear_encounter_data_file.csv",
                     trapfile="secr_bear_trap_data_file.csv",
                     detector="proximity", fmt="trapID")
summary(sch)
plot(sch)
```
## `secr` Model fits

### Model $M_0$
```{r}
fm_M0 <- secr.fit(
  sch,
  model=list(D=~1, g0=~1, sigma=~1),
  details = list(fastproximity = FALSE), 
  buffer=150, 
  trace=FALSE, 
  ncores=3
)

coef(fm_M0)
predict(fm_M0)
```

### Model $M_t$

```{r}
fm_Mt <- secr.fit(
  sch, 
  model=list(D=~1, g0=~t, sigma=~1),
  buffer=150, 
  trace=FALSE, 
  ncores=3
)

coef(fm_Mt)
predict(fm_Mt)
```

### Determine proper buffer value

```{r, warning = FALSE}
# We can graph the predicted values and visually expect when buffer is large enough for estimates to level off

buffer_seq <- seq(150, 1550, by = 100)

est_buffer <- matrix(0, nrow = length(buffer_seq), ncol = 2)

for(i in 1:length(buffer_seq)) {
  est_buffer[i,1] <- buffer_seq[i]
  est_buffer[i,2] <- predict(update(fm_M0, buffer=buffer_seq[i]))[1,]$estimate
}

plot(
  x=est_buffer[,1],
  y=est_buffer[,2],
  xlab = "Buffer Value",
  ylab = "Estimate"
)
```


### Refit `secr` models

We see that it levels off around 800m, so we can refit our models with `buffer=800`.

```{r}
fm_M0_updated <- secr.fit(
  sch,
  model=list(D=~1, g0=~1, sigma=~1),
  details = list(fastproximity = FALSE), 
  buffer=800, 
  trace=FALSE, 
  ncores=3
)

coef(fm_M0)
predict(fm_M0)
```

```{r}
fm_Mt_updated <- secr.fit(
  sch, 
  model=list(D=~1, g0=~t, sigma=~1),
  buffer=800, 
  trace=FALSE, 
  ncores=3
)

coef(fm_Mt)
predict(fm_Mt)
```

## `JAGS` Models

```{r}
load("jags_bear_data.gzip")

# determine and tabulate the number of captures per bear
capture_freq <- apply(
  caps.2016,
  1, 
  sum
)
table(capture_freq)

# number of spatial recaptures
n_locations <- apply(
  caps.2016, 
  1, 
  function(bear) {
    sum(rowSums(bear) > 0)
  }
)
table(n_locations)
```

```{r}
M <- 100 # population cap
J <- length(dimnames(caps.2016)[[2]]) # nTraps
K <- length(dimnames(caps.2016)[[3]]) # nOccasions

caps_aug <- array(0, c(M, J, K))
caps_aug[1:nrow(caps.2016),,] <- caps.2016

jags_data <- list(
  y=caps_aug,
  M=M,
  J=J,
  K=K,
  x=traps,
  xlim=c(min(traps[,1])-1000,max(traps[,1])+1000),
  ylim=c(min(traps[,2])-1000,max(traps[,2])+1000)
)

jags_inits <- function() {
  si <- cbind(runif(M, min(traps[,1]), max(traps[,1])),
              runif(M, min(traps[,2]), max(traps[,2])))

  for(i in 1:nrow(caps.2016)) {
    traps_with_dets_i <- rowSums(caps.2016[i,,] > 0) > 0

    si[i,] <- colMeans(
      traps[traps_with_dets_i, , drop = FALSE]
    )
  }

  list(
    z = rep(1, M),
    psi = runif(1),
    s = si,
    g = rep(runif(1, 0.1, 0.9), K),
    sigma = runif(1, 100, 500)
  )
}

jags_pars <- c("g", "sigma", "EN", "N")
```

```{r}
model_string_Mt <- "
model {
for(i in 1:K) {
  g[i] ~ dunif(0,1)
}
sigma ~ dunif(1, 2000)  
psi ~ dunif(0, 1)      

for(i in 1:M) {
  s[i,1] ~ dunif(xlim[1], xlim[2]) 
  s[i,2] ~ dunif(ylim[1], ylim[2]) 
  z[i] ~ dbern(psi)               
  for(j in 1:J) {
    dist[i,j] <- sqrt((s[i,1]-x[j,1])^2 + (s[i,2]-x[j,2])^2)
    for(k in 1:K) {
      p[i,j,k] <- g[k]*exp(-dist[i,j]^2/(2*sigma^2))
      y[i,j,k] ~ dbern(z[i]*p[i,j,k])
    }
  }
}

EN <- M*psi  
N <- sum(z) 
}
"

model_file_Mt <- tempfile(fileext = ".jags")
writeLines(model_string_Mt,
           con = model_file_Mt
           )

jags_post <- jags.basic(
  data=jags_data,
  inits=jags_inits,
  parameters.to.save = jags_pars,
  model.file = model_file_Mt,
  n.chains = 3,
  n.adapt = 100,
  n.burnin = 0,
  n.iter = 2000,
  parallel = TRUE
)
```
